_note: Library items drafted for Simulate v2 that are NOT in Chris's database yet. Each is pending review: Chris confirms, edits or replaces it, then adds it to the library and re-exports, and the item is removed from this file. Read alongside library_export.json by scripts/sim2_library_snapshot.mjs (and the run seam's constructions script). Linzie chose this route on 15 Nov 2026 (decision card: 'I draft one, Chris checks').

body.name: interior_wall_block_plastered
body.description: Internal wall: plaster skim, 100mm dense concrete block, plaster skim

provenance.drafted: 2026-11-15, Claude (Simulate v2 editor thread), on Linzie's decision
provenance.basis: No new numbers: the plaster layers copy IntFloor_Plaster from interior_floor_ceiling (13 mm, k 0.5, 1300 kg/m3, 1000 J/kgK) and the block copies CavWall_Std_ConcreteBlock from cavity_wall_standard (100 mm, k 0.51, 1400 kg/m3, 1000 J/kgK), both rows of Chris's library. Symmetric, so either face can be zone A.
provenance.review: Chris: confirm, edit or replace (e.g. a stud partition), then add to the library
provenance.display_name: Internal wall: plaster, 100mm block, plaster (draft, awaiting Chris)

body.name: timber_door_solid
body.description: External door: solid timber leaf, 44 mm

provenance.drafted: 2026-11-17, Claude (Simulate v2 editor thread), so a drawn door can run (the library has no door)
provenance.basis: One new number, the 44 mm leaf thickness (the usual external door leaf). The material copies TF_Std_OSB from timber_frame_standard, a row of Chris's library (k 0.13, 650 kg/m3, 1700 J/kgK). U about 2.0 W/m2K with the standard surface resistances (0.13 + 0.04); a U typed on the door type overrides it.
provenance.review: Chris: confirm, edit or replace (e.g. an insulated composite door), then add to the library
provenance.display_name: External door: solid timber, 44 mm (draft, awaiting Chris)

body.name: cavity_wall_unfilled_1960s

provenance.drafted: 2026-11-17, Claude (Simulate v2 example-school thread), for the worked example school (Linzie 17 Nov 21:28: "mix of old versus new fabric, different windows")
provenance.basis: One new number, the cavity's R 0.18 m2K/W (ISO 6946:2017 Table 8, unventilated air layer 25 mm or more, horizontal heat flow). body.name: ground_floor_uninsulated
